# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 26 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 36 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_026_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 26

**1** Jesus said: "You notice the speck in your brother's eye but you don't see the plank in your own.

**2** Once you take the plank out of your own eye, then you'll see well enough to take the speck out of your brother's."

---

**Translation Notes (PNEUMA):**
- "Speck" — the tiny particle; "splinter" is more specific but "speck" captures the smallness
- "Plank" — the large timber; "beam" is traditional but "plank" is more vivid
- "See well enough" — the restored vision rendered practically
